name: cover
description: Avenida Sol at golden hour: the camera drifts south-west down the downtown boulevard, sun low over the harbour, towers behind.

name: drive
description: A stolen teal coupe rolling north through the downtown traffic on the Avenida Sol, the towers ahead and the chase camera low behind the off-side quarter.

name: street
description: On foot on the Neon Strip at dusk: the player on the corner pavement, pedestrians walking the block and traffic crossing the junction behind.

name: night
description: The Neon Strip after midnight: lit windows, streetlights and blade signs under the moon.
